name: Quick Clean Dinners
instructions: Keep a rotating shortlist of 5-6 dinners you can make in 20 minutes or less with ingredients you usually have on hand.
Pre-chop vegetables for the week in one session so "quick" dinners stay quick even on tired nights.
Use canned or frozen convenience ingredients (canned beans, frozen stir-fry veg) without guilt -- they are still real, nutritious food.
Watch today's video for five more quick, healthy dinner ideas.
